description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  
 > * Assist with definition, design, prototyping, implementation, 

 > testing, debugging, verification, and deployment of Oracle, Java,
 > WebLogic, and GlassFish project requirements.
 > * Assist to maintain software functionality.
 > * Develop and maintain technical documentation for
 > developed/maintained functionality.
 > * Assist other developers, testers, and/or client stakeholders to
 > understand relevant requirements.
 > * Perform configuration management tasks for projects. 
 

 > WORK EXPERIENCE:  
 > * At least six (6) years of experience developing and maintaining  medium- to high-complexity software applications required. 
 > * Experience with Oracle, Java, WebLogic, and GlassFish development  and maintenance required. 
 > * Experience with Adobe Flex development and maintenance preferred.
 > * Experience with ColdFusion development and maintenance preferred.
 > * Proven experience working with users in an Agile environment to  understand requirements, elicit feedback, and refine solutions via  demonstrations.  
 
 

 
 JOB SKILLS:  
 > * Enthusiastic, proactive, positive attitude with good listening  skills and high integrity. 
 > * Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and  ability to support projects supporting multiple organizations  effectively. 
 > * Ability to assist in the synthesis or combination of facts and  details from different sources into coherent narratives. 
 > * Ability to work under pressure (at times) and be extremely   flexible under changing priorities. 
 > * Ability to assist with the identification of innovative ways to  solve problems. 
 > * Ability to work in a team environment.
 > * At least three (3) years of Java experience.
 > * WebLogic, Glassfish, and Tomcat 5.5.15+ experience.
 > * VMware vSphere versions 5 through 5.5+ experience.
 > * Content management system (CMS) experience such as DRUPAL, Joomla,  or Word Press. 
 > * Configuration Management experience such as Serena CM.
 > * Windows 2008 Active Directory/XP/Win7 experience.
 > * Unix/Linux experience.
 

 > CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, AND REGISTRATIONS:  
 > * Relevant programming certifications preferred. 

 

 > COMMUNICATION SKILLS:  
 > * Excellent business and technical communication skills including the  following:  
 > * Written: 
 > * Email
 > * Documentation 
 > * Oral: 
 > * Presentation
 > * Virtual (e.g., Web Conferencing)
 > * Telephone

 > EDUCATION: 
 > * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems,
 > Engineering, or relevant field of study required.
 > * Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems,
 > Engineering, or relevant field of study preferred.
